editor.title: Island editor
editor.subtitle: Draw each monitor's islands to real scale: drag to move them and pull their edges to resize.
editor.err.not_number: Enter a number: whole pixels, or a fraction (0.5 or 0,5 both work)
editor.err.out_of_monitor: The island must stay inside the monitor
editor.err.non_positive: Width and height must be greater than zero
editor.issue.layout_id_dup: Another layout already has this id
editor.issue.island_id_dup: Another island in this layout already has this id
editor.issue.profile_ref: The profile for {process} uses the island {island}, which will stop existing once you save.
editor.issue.aspect: {process}: the game runs at {game} and the island {island} is {size}; the picture will not fill the island.
editor.issue.outside: {name} also changed outside the editor; your version is kept. Review it before saving.
editor.gate.readonly: Read-only: this profiles file cannot be changed from here
editor.gate.conflict: First decide what to do about the external change to the file
editor.gate.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish
editor.gate.errors: Fix the errors under "Issues" to be able to save
editor.gate.clean: There are no changes to save
editor.problem.profile_error: The profiles file cannot be read: it may be damaged or not valid JSON. Fix it by hand; meanwhile the editor is read-only and does not overwrite it.
editor.problem.unsupported_version: The profiles file is from a newer version of Borderless Shatter. Update the app to edit it; meanwhile the editor is read-only.
editor.problem.transport: Cannot connect to Borderless Shatter. Start it with "Start" in the sidebar or from the tray icon and try again.
editor.notice.layout_removed: Layout "{id}" removed from the draft. Save to remove it from the file.
editor.notice.reloaded_outside: The profiles file changed outside the editor and was reloaded.
editor.notice.rebased: File reloaded: your changes are kept on top of the new version. Review them and save again.
editor.save_error_hint: Your changes are still in the draft.
editor.no_monitors.title: No monitors
editor.no_monitors.body: The resident process has not reported any connected screen.
editor.conflict.title: The profiles file changed while you were editing
editor.conflict.body: Another program or a manual edit modified it. Nothing was saved: choose how to go on. Your draft is not lost unless you discard it.
editor.preset_readonly: {name} is a built-in layout and cannot be changed. Duplicate it to make your own editable version.
editor.monitor_missing: This layout's monitor is not connected. Connect it or pick another monitor to edit its islands.
editor.help_edit: Double-click an empty spot on the monitor to create an island. With the preview focused: arrows move 1 px (Shift: 10), Alt+arrows resize, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Hold Alt while dragging to skip snapping.
editor.help_paused: Editing is paused until you decide how to handle the change to the file (see above). Your draft is kept.
editor.fields_help: Physical monitor pixels, or fractions from 0 to 1 (0.5 or 0,5 both work). Press Enter or leave the field to apply.
editor.issues_none: No issues: the draft can be saved.
